character_technical_data.growth_mechanics: Character stats grow across 13 distinct stages from level 1 to 99. For example, Maxim gains a minimum of 7 HP per level in Stage 1 (levels 1-8) but only a minimum of 3 HP per level in Stage 13 (levels 96-99).

advanced_game_secrets.ancient_cave_rules: A 99-floor dungeon where you enter at level 1 with no gear. Only rare 'Blue Chest' items can be permanently removed from the cave. After floor 20, players must find the 'Providence' item to exit the cave successfully.
